candidate_family: V1 raw_plus_acc 273D logistic contact plus ridge 3D force, same alpha=300 C=0.3 warmup=10 threshold=0.6
train: old 120 episodes plus new seeds 213-236 oracle and V1-estimated trajectories
development: old 24 validation episodes and new seeds 237-244 oracle and V1-estimated trajectories
locked_test: new seeds 245-252, untouched until one candidate is frozen
selection: among passing candidates: fewest estimated-arm true-peak misses, then lowest estimated-arm median run vector MAE; if none pass, do not open locked test or promote
promotion: requires same old safety and fresh locked estimated-arm criteria plus closed-loop comparison; no PPO in this stage
